drupal/core.description: Form errors from a previous request block form submission in persistent workers
Avoid duplicate namespace paths when a persistent kernel boots again
Remove the static Settings instance from default admin theme for persistent workers
Remove static translation caches from Views::getHandlerTypes() for persistent workers
Reset destroyed session state and verify cookie identity across FrankenPHP worker requests
Reset kernel preparation and release the request even when termination fails (FrankenPHP workers)
Restore router context after error-page subrequests (FrankenPHP workers)
PageCache cannot handle multiple main requests (FrankenPHP workers)
Add FrankenPHP Caddyfile scaffold and protect it from Apache access
Keep all services between FrankenPHP requests and reset listed ones in place; reload the container when another process rebuilds it

extra.local-adaptation: terminate() and handle() hunks rebased onto the kernel termination MR !17249 and the form-errors MR; worker_mode is based on main without them.
extra.requires: patches/core-persistent-entity-type-manager-reset.patch (EntityTypeManager::reset()), patches/core-persistent-account-proxy-reset.patch (AccountProxy::reset(); the only fix for the previous user's account and time zone leaking into anonymous requests), and patches/core-persistent-event-dispatcher-reset.patch (removes runtime listeners). The reset list calls these as optional '?reset' methods, so a missing patch fails silently.

drupal/core.description: Add AccountProxy::reset() so anonymous FrankenPHP requests do not run as the previous user
Redirect only the next response in GotoAction so the listener does not stay on a reused event dispatcher (FrankenPHP workers)
Remove event listeners added at runtime when the event dispatcher is reset (FrankenPHP workers)
Let EntityTypeManager be reused across FrankenPHP requests: service closures for request-scoped dependencies and a reset() that drops handlers
Reset HTML IDs and AJAX mode before each main request
Release requests held by renderer contexts in persistent workers
Release native session handler references between worker requests
Consume request shutdown callbacks and rearm transaction cleanup in workers

extra.local-adaptation: Compose termination cleanup with the kernel termination MR !17249 finally block; retain its prepared-state reset.

drupal/core.description: Release the Drupal MIME guesser from Symfony singleton ownership between worker requests
isFrontPage() returns a stale result after the current route changes
Reset theme state between persistent worker requests
PathValidator does not restore router context when matching throws an unhandled exception
